title: Assignment from its block code
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on distinct coordinates with width at most $w$. For any block code $B$ on $w$ positions and any literal position $j$ in $T$, the assignment constructed from $B$ for $T$ at that literal's coordinate equals the bit of $B$ at the embedded position of $j$, adjusted by the inverse sign encoding of that literal's required sign.
hypotheses_covered: A term T on n coordinates
The width of T is at most w
A block code B on w positions
A literal position j in T
